content.title: Trump Media's Q3 loss, Microsoft eyes longest sell-off since 2011
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Julie Hyman tracks Friday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Sweetgreen (SG) stock is plunging after the company cut its full-year outlook.

Trump Media (DJT) reported a bigger third quarter loss than last year in the same period.

Microsoft (MSFT) stock is on track to reach its longest sell-off since 2011.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
